The discussions and diagrams helped connect structure to intent. They gave me a way to look beyond the arrangement of classes and ask why that arrangement might be useful—and what it would mean for later changes.

That is where the book became more than a collection of techniques for me. It offered a vocabulary for discussing design choices that can otherwise be difficult to explain precisely.

The “Ah!” moment depends on experience
